what_its_for: This medicine is used to treat tension headaches. It contains three ingredients that work together: butalbital relaxes muscle tension, acetaminophen (also known as Tylenol) relieves pain and reduces fever, and caffeine helps the other medicines work better and improves blood flow.
how_to_take: Take this medicine by mouth with a full glass of water. You may take it with food or milk if it upsets your stomach. Do not crush or chew the tablets or capsules — swallow them whole. Take only as many doses as your doctor prescribed and do not take it more often than directed. This medicine can become habit-forming, so only use it when you have a headache, not to prevent one.
dosing: The usual adult dose is 1 to 2 tablets or capsules every 4 hours as needed for headache pain. Do not take more than 6 tablets or capsules in one day (24 hours). Do not use this medicine for more than 2 days per week on a regular basis, as using it too often can actually cause more headaches (called medication overuse headache or rebound headache). Always follow your doctor's specific instructions.
missed_dose: This medicine is taken only when you have a headache, not on a regular schedule. If your doctor has given you a specific dosing schedule and you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose as scheduled. Do not double up or take two doses at the same time.
storage: Store at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep this medicine away from heat, direct sunlight, and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Keep it in a secure location out of the reach of children and pets. Do not share this medicine with anyone else — it is a controlled substance and sharing it is illegal.
what_to_avoid: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine. Alcohol combined with acetaminophen can cause serious liver damage, and alcohol combined with butalbital can cause dangerous drowsiness. Avoid driving, operating heavy machinery, or doing anything that requires you to be alert until you know how this medicine affects you, because it can cause dizziness and drowsiness. Check all other medicines, including over-the-counter products like cold medicines, sleep aids, and pain relievers, for acetaminophen — taking too much acetaminophen from multiple products can harm your liver. Avoid taking other sedatives, sleeping pills, or anxiety medicines unless your doctor approves.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away or go to the emergency room if you notice yellowing of your skin or eyes (jaundice), dark urine, severe stomach pain, or unusual tiredness, as these may be signs of liver problems. Also seek immediate help if you have an allergic reaction with symptoms like rash, hives, swelling of your face or throat, or trouble breathing. Call your doctor if your headaches are happening more often or getting worse, if you feel you need to take this medicine every day, if you feel shaky, anxious, or sick when you do not take it (signs of dependence), or if this medicine stops working as well as it used to.
when_it_works: Most people start to feel headache relief within 30 to 60 minutes of taking a dose. The medicine usually works for about 4 to 6 hours. If your headache does not improve after taking the recommended dose, do not take extra doses — contact your doctor instead.
special_populations: Older adults (age 65 and older) should use this medicine with extra caution because butalbital can cause increased dizziness, confusion, and fall risk. This medicine is generally not recommended for children unless specifically prescribed by a doctor. If you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, talk to your doctor before taking this medicine — butalbital may cause dependence in newborns if used during pregnancy. This medicine passes into breast milk and is not recommended while breastfeeding. If you have liver disease, kidney disease, a history of substance abuse, depression, or breathing problems, make sure your doctor knows before you take this medicine.
